notes.title: Battl – Official Steam Release Incoming!
notes.content:
🎮 Game Announcement 🎮
We’re thrilled to announce that our PC game "Battl" is officially on its way! 🚀
It’s currently under review on Steam, and we’re getting closer to launch. Get ready for intense action, high-quality visuals, and a thrilling experience.

Stay tuned — the battlefield is almost here! 🔥
